scope: three-fold BDG2 reduced-grid benchmark, model seed 42

paired_contrast.main_exploratory_paired_contrast: static immediate CQR minus static immediate uncalibrated
paired_contrast.workload_pool: sum original clean episodes / sum original asset-days; never multiply exposure by catalogue count
paired_contrast.recall_pool: sum N and TP within each of 21 strata across folds and all catalogues, then equal-stratum mean
paired_contrast.paired_ci: approximate percentile 95%; resample ten original buildings with all fold/catalogue contributions together
paired_contrast.inference: exploratory conditional; no significance/equivalence/same-recall superiority claim
paired_contrast.outer_comparisons: derive from actual frozen selection, fixed controls, independent subsets, inverse and persistence; no reselection
paired_contrast.limitations: post-inspection design; fold 2 already inspected; historical period repeatability, not prospective or unseen buildings
